description: The KL-44 RTO office is the Sub-Regional Transport Office (SRTO) serving the Kothamangalam region in Ernakulam district. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the eastern high-range areas of the district. The office plays a crucial role in regulating traffic and vehicle safety under the Kerala Motor Vehicles Department.
address: 3rd Floor, Revenue Tower, Near Municipal Bus Stand, Kothamangalam, Kerala
